sloka: शुभ क्षेत्र गतः च अहम् तव संदर्शनात् प्रभो ।ब्रूहि यत् प्रार्थितम् तुभ्यम् कार्यम् आगमनम् प्रति ॥१-१८-५६॥
transliteration: śubha kṣetra gataḥ ca aham tava saṁdarśanāt prabho ।brūhi yat prārthitam tubhyam kāryam āgamanam prati ॥1-18-56॥

translations.english: O Viswamitra you need not hesitatate to tell me what ought to be performed. I shall accomplish that act in every possible special way. You are a god to me.
